definitions.gloss: drifting ashore; washing up; being carried to shore
definitions.explanation: The arrival of something at a shore after drifting on water. Used for both objects (debris, driftwood) and people (castaways, refugees) that reach land after being carried by ocean currents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{漂着|ひょうちゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Garbage washed ashore on the beach.

examples.japanese: {漂着|ひょうちゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浜辺|はまべ}→浜辺：17948_hamabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散|ち}らばっていた→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧。
examples.english: Driftwood that had washed ashore was scattered across the beach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プラスチックゴミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漂着|ひょうちゃく}し、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたった。
examples.english: After the typhoon, a large amount of plastic garbage washed ashore, and local volunteers handled the cleanup.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly appears in news reports about marine debris, environmental issues, and occasionally in stories about castaways or lost ships. Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

FORMS:
{漂|ひょう} (to drift, to float) + ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (to arrive, to reach).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漂着|ひょうちゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to drift ashore — verb form)
- {漂着|ひょうちゃく}{物|ぶつ} (flotsam, drifted items)
- {漂着|ひょうちゃく}⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (washed-up garbage)
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{漂着|ひょうちゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to wash up on the coast)
